title: Fixed deposits, tenure and eligibility - support procedure
content: The fictional Call Sense Bank FD is described in the configured product schedule. A demo agent explains the available tenure and sample rate, while opening a real deposit must happen through an authenticated institution channel.
customer_content: Before opening a fixed deposit, review the tenure, applicable rate, maturity instruction and early-withdrawal terms. Use an authenticated banking channel to apply, and confirm the terms before placing funds.
